bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to energy; exempting certain municipal electric utilities from the life-cycle analysis requirement; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 216B.1691, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 216B.1691, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 11.+]

[+Municipal electric utility exemption.+]

[+(a) A municipal electric utility located in the city of Hibbing that was in operation before the commission's decision in docket number 24-352 is exempt from: +]

[+(1) a requirement to submit a facility specific life-cycle analysis of waste-derived fuel; +]

[+(2) a requirement to submit a fuel mix report; and +]

[+(3) reevaluation requirements. +]

[+(b) The electricity generated by waste-derived fuel at a municipal electric utility must be considered when determining whether the municipal electric utility satisfies the eligible energy technology standard under subdivision 2a. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to energy; exempting certain municipal electric utilities from the life-cycle analysis requirement; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 216B.1691, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 216B.1691, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 11.

Municipal electric utility exemption.

(a) A municipal electric utility located in the city of Hibbing that was in operation before the commission's decision in docket number 24-352 is exempt from:

(1) a requirement to submit a facility specific life-cycle analysis of waste-derived fuel;

(2) a requirement to submit a fuel mix report; and

(3) reevaluation requirements.

(b) The electricity generated by waste-derived fuel at a municipal electric utility must be considered when determining whether the municipal electric utility satisfies the eligible energy technology standard under subdivision 2a.
additions: (a) A municipal electric utility located in the city of Hibbing that was in operation before the commission's decision in docket number 24-352 is exempt from:
(1) a requirement to submit a facility specific life-cycle analysis of waste-derived fuel;
(2) a requirement to submit a fuel mix report; and

(b) The electricity generated by waste-derived fuel at a municipal electric utility must be considered when determining whether the municipal electric utility satisfies the eligible energy technology standard under subdivision 2a.
